# Copilot agents in this repository

This repository includes optional task-specific Copilot agent profiles in `.github/agents/`:

- **Portfolio editor** — improves profile and portfolio copy using verifiable information.
- **Quality reviewer** — checks changes for accuracy, accessibility, privacy, and link quality.
- **Suggestion triager** — summarizes public suggestions for the maintainer to review.

These are instructions for agents available through GitHub Copilot features; they do not install or run agents by themselves. To use them, start an agent task for this repository and select the relevant custom agent if it is available in your GitHub Copilot interface. Availability depends on your account, plan, and repository settings.

Agents may draft or review work, but they must not automatically approve, merge, or publish public contributions. Review changes yourself before merging. Third-party agents require separate selection, authorization, and possibly installation; none have been installed by this repository change.
